responsibility: Implements the core C++ half of the FT32 GCC target backend: target hooks for calling convention and return-value placement, argument passing and varargs, frame/prologue/epilogue generation, address legitimacy and pointer/address-space handling, section-selection and ELF symbol tagging for program-memory versus data-memory objects, operand/address assembly printing, and various FT32-specific helper routines such as bitfield/immediate formatting and memory-space classification. It is the file that binds FT32-specific policies into targetm and supports the RTL patterns defined in ft32.md.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling ft32.h, ft32.md, and ft32.opt files, this is the executable C++ implementation file that installs FT32 target hooks into targetm and provides helper code those other files depend on, such as operand/address printers, calling-convention logic, address-legitimacy checks, and program-memory section encoding.
